data.name: Roohi
data.gender_notes: Roohi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Roohi is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Ruh' which means soul, spirit. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking images of light, wisdom, and intelligence. The name Roohi carries the meaning “Spirit, Soul” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Roohi usually hope their child will grow to embody spirit, soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Roohi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spirit, Soul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roohi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
